message.content: The held-out grader failed one case. Let me re-check the task spec for details I may have missed.
message.reasoning_content:
Held-out case 4 failed. No details. Let me think about what edge case might fail. Possible issues:

1. Empty columns with rows: I output header line "\r\n" then one line per row "\r\n". If columns empty, header is "" followed by CRLF. Maybe expected output when columns empty is just per-row CRLFs without header? Spec says "Return a str containing CSV header then one record per row" — header always included. Hmm.

2. Maybe quoting of the header? Column names containing special chars should be quoted — my render_record handles that.

3. Maybe values that are strings should not be str()'d — fine.

4. Edge: maybe rows containing more fields — ignored, fine.

5. Maybe the trailing CRLF — some graders expect no trailing CRLF on last record? RFC 4180 says last record may or may not have CRLF. Spec says "CSV header then one record per row" — ambiguous. Case 4 could be empty-rows case where trailing CRLF expected or not.

6. Possibly rows as mapping with non-dict — row.get used; spec says mappings so .get fine.

Let me re-read TASK.txt and requirements to see if there are hints.
